name: Duke City Kids
tagline: Find kids' activities in Albuquerque — swim, martial arts, dance, camps & tutoring.

categories.name: Swim Lessons
categories.blurb: Year-round indoor swim schools, public pool lessons and private instructors across Albuquerque and Rio Rancho.

categories.name: Martial Arts
categories.blurb: Taekwondo, karate, jiu jitsu and more — dojos and academies with classes built for kids.

categories.name: Gymnastics & Dance
categories.blurb: Ballet, hip-hop, tumbling and gymnastics studios for toddlers through teens.

categories.name: Summer Camps
categories.blurb: Day camps, STEM camps, arts camps and city programs to fill the summer.

categories.name: Tutoring
categories.blurb: Learning centers, math programs and one-on-one tutors for K–12 students.
